copy.services.transport.title: Transport & Logistics
copy.services.transport.promise: Moved on time, tracked end to end.
copy.services.transport.body: Regular routes for the loads you can plan, and extra vehicles for the ones you cannot.
copy.services.transport.world.headline:
Moved on time.
Tracked to the door.
What moves, from where, how often, and what it costs you if it is late.
Route built, load sequenced by drop order, slot confirmed in writing.
Collected, sealed and tracked, with exceptions reported before you ask.
Signed and timestamped at the door, proof returned the same day.
copy.services.transport.world.lede: Most delivery problems start with not knowing. You hear about a delay when it is already too late to do anything about it. We tell you first, so you never have to chase us.
copy.services.transport.world.route.0.d: Manifest built, load sequenced by drop order.
copy.services.transport.world.route.1.d: Checked against the manifest and sealed.
copy.services.transport.world.route.2.d: Live position, with an ETA that updates itself.
copy.services.transport.world.route.3.d: If it slips, you hear it from us first.
copy.services.transport.world.route.4.d: Signed, timestamped, proof returned same day.
copy.services.transport.world.definition: Fixed routes for volume you can predict a month out.
Capacity within the day for the volume you cannot.
Internal movement across your own locations.
We tell you when it leaves, when something changes and when it arrives.
copy.services.transport.world.audience.l: For organisations where a late delivery costs more than the delivery itself.
copy.services.transport.world.audience.i: Stock between depot and floor, ahead of opening.
Parts and pallets on a line that cannot wait.
Time-critical items with a chain of custody.
Documents, equipment and post between buildings.
copy.services.transport.world.inside.0.d: Consolidated runs, so you are not paying for half-empty vans crossing the same city twice.
copy.services.transport.world.inside.1.d: Captured at the door, signed, timestamped and returned to you.
copy.services.transport.world.inside.2.d: If something slips, the message reaches you before it reaches your customer.
copy.services.transport.world.inside.3.d: Fragile, temperature-controlled, oversized or restricted-access, agreed up front.
copy.services.transport.world.inside.4.d: Local, national and cross-border, all on one agreement.
Capitals on the network, Paris to Berlin
copy.services.transport.world.prompt: Tell us what needs to move, and how often.
copy.services.workforce.title: Workforce
copy.services.workforce.promise: From one skilled worker to a complete flex pool or project crew.
copy.services.workforce.body: Qualified people for your operation in twelve sectors, as temporary staff, on secondment, as permanent hires or as a complete project team.
copy.services.workforce.world.headline:
The right people
for your operation.
copy.services.workforce.world.lede: We tell you plainly what is possible and which documents have been checked before anyone starts. You make one request, and one team is responsible for it.
copy.services.workforce.world.stripNote: We list a role only where we can recruit, select and support people for it. The list is still under review, so these numbers may come down.
copy.services.workforce.world.method.0.k: We move fast and choose carefully
copy.services.workforce.world.method.0.d: Your request takes minutes to record. After that, one person at ORYX owns it.
copy.services.workforce.world.method.1.d: We settle what the work is, then who is allowed to do it, and only then the dates.
copy.services.workforce.world.method.2.d: Documents, site instructions and the placement itself are checked, in that order.
copy.services.workforce.world.trust.line: A job title does not tell you everything about a person.
copy.services.workforce.world.trust.d: We check the evidence before we promise anything. Technology can make a suggestion, but our own staff make the decision and can overrule it.
copy.services.workforce.world.trust.hold: Availability and qualifications are reconfirmed for every assignment.
A certificate does not automatically grant authority.
A status applies to one assignment for a set period. It is not a general certificate for the person.
This website never promises more than ORYX can prove.
copy.services.workforce.world.prompt: Which people does your schedule need?
copy.services.renovation.title: Renovation
copy.services.renovation.promise: One plan for your property, and one team accountable for it.
copy.services.renovation.body: Maintenance, renovation and heritage restoration run from one plan, from the first property assessment through to handover and aftercare.
copy.services.renovation.world.headline:
Property that
keeps performing.
copy.services.renovation.world.lede: ORYX organises property maintenance, renovation and heritage restoration from one plan, and shows you the results.
copy.services.renovation.world.forkHead: A clear choice: maintain, improve or transform.
copy.services.renovation.world.forkLede: Start by deciding what the property needs. The list of trades comes after that.
One plan, one accountable team and results you can check.
copy.services.renovation.world.forkSet: Scope, phasing and budget range are set at the ORYX Property Check, for whichever is chosen.
copy.services.renovation.world.scenarios: Coordinate maintenance to the envelope, roof, structure and common areas.
Condition insight appropriate to the brief.
Combine technical improvement with comfort, health and energy performance.
Energy-performance and permit requirements depend on the work. This is a scenario with expected effects, not a guarantee.
A new function for an existing building.
Prepare existing property for a new function or layout.
We look at feasibility and risk first, then at scope, programme and delivery.
copy.services.renovation.world.routeLine: The route is the same whatever the service; only the scope of step three changes.
copy.services.renovation.world.toolsNote: Both are methods, not products. Neither is a portal, a dashboard or a live feed.
copy.services.renovation.world.trust.lin: We show evidence before we make promises, and publish only what ORYX can actually deliver.
copy.services.renovation.world.cross.d: This page is work ORYX delivers as complete packages. Skilled people for your own team to manage is ORYX Workforce.
copy.services.renovation.world.check.d: A few details are enough to start: the type of property, where it is, what needs doing and when you would like to begin.

workforce.sectors.technical.groups.engin: Work preparation, CAD, engineering, technical management and project leadership.
workforce.sectors.manufacturing.name: Manufacturing & Process Industries
workforce.sectors.manufacturing.blurb: Production, assembly, process, quality, shift leadership and operational support across manual and continuous production.
workforce.sectors.manufacturing.groups.p: Shop-floor people who keep products moving. Food, metal, plastics and pharma are filters, not duplicate job titles.
workforce.sectors.manufacturing.groups.m: Operators matched to machine, line and process. Operator is not a universal authorisation.
workforce.sectors.manufacturing.groups.q: Control over quality, staffing and progress. Quality control and quality assurance stay separate.
workforce.sectors.infrastructure.name: Infrastructure, Civil Works & Telecom
workforce.sectors.infrastructure.blurb: Groundworks, paving, cables, utilities and telecom profiles within one project chain. Security remains a separate sector.
The core workforce for groundworks, public infrastructure and underground networks.
From route to active connection. Groundworks and network installation remain separate trades in the same programme.
Control of delivery and handover: preparation, supervision, engineering, utility data and setting out.
workforce.sectors.traffic.name: Traffic Control & Traffic Management
workforce.sectors.traffic.blurb: Traffic controllers and operational traffic measures, kept as strictly separated roles with different legal authority.
workforce.sectors.traffic.groups.traffic: Roles for traffic flow and visitor routing. The legal role determines which directions a person may give.
workforce.sectors.traffic.groups.tempora: Roles for work-zone layout and equipment. This crew installs and removes the work zone under the delivery plan.
workforce.sectors.traffic.groups.prepara: Control of planning and delivery, from work preparation and CAD to project coordination.
workforce.sectors.agriculture.name: Agriculture, Horticulture, Fruit & Green
workforce.sectors.agriculture.blurb: Cultivation, harvest, greenhouse, livestock, sorting, landscaping and agricultural logistics across three specialist fields.
workforce.sectors.agriculture.groups.cro: Core roles from plant to product. Crops and production systems become filters.
workforce.sectors.agriculture.groups.liv: Continuity on the farm, in the barn and in the field. Animal group and machine are agreed per assignment.
workforce.sectors.agriculture.groups.lan: People for construction, maintenance and outdoor assets, across gardens, public grounds, trees and turf.
workforce.sectors.agriculture.groups.on-: Management profiles shown as available only where ORYX has demonstrable capacity.
workforce.sectors.waste.name: Waste, Recycling & Circularity
workforce.sectors.waste.blurb: Collection, sorting, processing, recycling, site work and circular operations, from kerbside to recovered material.
workforce.sectors.waste.groups.collectio: People who receive waste streams and keep them moving safely. Vehicle and material type are filters, not job titles.
workforce.sectors.waste.groups.sorting-r: Shop-floor people who turn waste back into value. Material is a filter, not a new occupation.
workforce.sectors.waste.groups.plant-pro: Control over equipment, site, planning and shift. Machine experience is task- and site-specific.
workforce.sectors.healthcare.name: Healthcare & Social Care
workforce.sectors.healthcare.blurb: Care, support and welfare profiles across six care settings, from daily support to clinical care and coordination.
workforce.sectors.healthcare.groups.pers: Professionals for daily care and clinical support. Care intensity and autonomy determine the required profile.
workforce.sectors.healthcare.groups.supp: People who support, activate and strengthen autonomy. Setting is a filter, not a new occupation.
workforce.sectors.healthcare.groups.mate: Continuity for children, home, roster and team. Childcare has its own diploma and registration route.
workforce.sectors.maritime.name: Maritime, Port & Offshore
workforce.sectors.maritime.blurb: Terminal, port, inland and sea-going shipping, marine engineering and offshore profiles, with separate qualification routes.
workforce.sectors.maritime.groups.port-a: Capacity for quay, yard and terminal. Equipment evidence is assignment-specific, never a general authorisation.
workforce.sectors.maritime.groups.inland: Separate qualification routes. Inland and sea-going occupations are not interchangeable.
workforce.sectors.maritime.groups.offsho: Technical and marine profiles for work at sea. Safety training is not trade authorisation.
workforce.sectors.retail.name: Retail, Sales & Customer Contact
workforce.sectors.retail.blurb: Retail sales, inside sales, outbound and inbound contact and commercial administration across five commercial routes.
workforce.sectors.retail.groups.retail-a: Customer-focused capacity for sales, service and store support. Sales Associate and Sales Advisor stay separate.
workforce.sectors.retail.groups.sales-an: Commercial profiles for B2C, B2B, inbound and outbound. Industry is a filter; the occupation stays commercial.
workforce.sectors.retail.groups.customer: Service, back office and leadership without duplicate job titles. Service is not automatically a sales role.
workforce.sectors.retail.groups.on-reque: Quality and planning specialists confirmed per request rather than published as core profiles.
